talentPool.title: Talent pool
talentPool.subtitle: Find matching candidates with AI semantic search across the consented CV pool.
talentPool.jdPlaceholder: Paste a job description here — even one you haven't posted yet…
talentPool.jdHelp: AI reads the JD to find the closest-matching candidates. You can paste a JD for a role that isn't posted yet.
talentPool.skillsPlaceholder: Type a skill and press Enter…
talentPool.skillsHelp: Press Enter or comma to add. Up to 25 skills.
talentPool.aiHint: Ranked by AI semantic search over consented profiles. Results show match strength and reasons — never a score.
talentPool.needCriteriaHint: Enter at least one criterion: a JD, skills, or a description.
talentPool.startBody: Paste a JD, add skills, or describe your hiring need and AI will find the best-matching candidates in the pool.
talentPool.resultsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No candidates} =1 {1 matching candidate} other {# matching candidates}}
talentPool.sourceFallbackHint: Using keyword and skill matching instead of AI. Try again later for full AI results.
talentPool.emptyBody: No profiles match these criteria yet. Try loosening the skills, lowering the experience minimum, or using a broader JD.
talentPool.lockedBody: Your account hasn't been granted access to candidate profiles. Ask your organization admin for access.
talentPool.needCriteriaBody: Paste a JD, add skills, or type a hiring need, then search again.
talentPool.profileNotVisibleBody: The student may have changed their visibility settings, or you don't have access to it.
talentPool.cvReviewHint: Career details live in this student's CVs. Reach out through a job or open a shared application to review their CV.
